partners.mechanism_chain: DHH (HGNC:2890) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-169977); Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-169977) —LEADS_TO→ Gonadal Development Disruption (HP:0001398); Gonadal Development Disruption (HP:0001398) —LEADS_TO→ 46,XY sex reversal (MONDO:0009301); ADGRE2 (HGNC:28904) —DISRUPTS→ Immune Response / Mast Cell Activation (GO:0006955); Immune Response / Mast Cell Activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Hives (HP:0001054); Hives (HP:0001054) —LEADS_TO→ Vibratory Urticaria (MONDO:0007447). Loss-of-function mutations in DHH disrupt normal steroidogenesis, leading to impaired gonadal development and 46,XY sex reversal. Gain-of-function mutations in ADGRE2 dysregulate immune responses, specifically mast cell activation, resulting in vibratory urticaria. The convergence occurs at the level of distinct cellular signaling pathways that, when disrupted, manifest as the respective disease phenotypes.
